bill_payments_share.name: bill_payments_share
bill_payments_share.value:
("bill_payments"."mode" = 'equal') = ("bill_payments"."share_index" IS NOT NULL AND "bill_payments"."share_count" IS NOT NULL)
        AND ("bill_payments"."share_count" IS NULL OR ("bill_payments"."share_count" BETWEEN 2 AND 20
          AND "bill_payments"."share_index" BETWEEN 1 AND "bill_payments"."share_count"))

bill_payments_method.name: bill_payments_method
bill_payments_method.value:
("bill_payments"."method" = 'online' AND ("bill_payments"."payment_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bill_payments"."status" <> 'succeeded'))
        OR ("bill_payments"."method" <> 'online' AND "bill_payments"."payment_id" IS NULL AND "bill_payments"."recorded_by_user_id" IS NOT NULL)

customer_reviews_subject_target.name: customer_reviews_subject_target
customer_reviews_subject_target.value:
("customer_reviews"."subject" = 'reservation' AND "customer_reviews"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_reviews"."table_session_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("customer_reviews"."subject" = 'visit' AND "customer_reviews"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customer_reviews"."reservation_id" IS NULL)

reservation_holds_expiry_idx.name: reservation_holds_expiry_idx
reservation_holds_expiry_idx.where: "reservation_holds"."released_at" IS NULL AND "reservation_holds"."expires_at" IS NOT NULL

restaurant_locations_reservation_setting.name: restaurant_locations_reservation_settings
restaurant_locations_reservation_setting.value: reservation_duration_minutes BETWEEN 30 AND 360 AND reservation_min_notice_minutes BETWEEN 0 AND 10080 AND reservation_max_days_ahead BETWEEN 1 AND 365

restaurant_locations_deposit.name: restaurant_locations_deposit
restaurant_locations_deposit.value: (reservation_deposit_type = 'none' OR reservation_deposit_minor > 0) AND reservation_deposit_minor BETWEEN 0 AND 100000000 AND reservation_refund_cutoff_hours BETWEEN 0 AND 168

restaurant_locations_coordinates.name: restaurant_locations_coordinates
restaurant_locations_coordinates.value: ("restaurant_locations"."latitude" IS NULL AND "restaurant_locations"."longitude" IS NULL) OR ("restaurant_locations"."latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "restaurant_locations"."longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "restaurant_locations"."latitude" BETWEEN -90 AND 90 AND "restaurant_locations"."longitude" BETWEEN -180 AND 180)

reviews_one_per_visit_user.name: reviews_one_per_visit_user
reviews_one_per_visit_user.where: "reviews"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."author_user_id" IS NOT NULL

reviews_one_per_visit_guest.name: reviews_one_per_visit_guest
reviews_one_per_visit_guest.where: "reviews"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."author_guest_id" IS NOT NULL

reviews_reported_idx.name: reviews_reported_idx
reviews_reported_idx.where: "reviews"."reported_at" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."moderated_at" IS NULL

reviews_subject_target.name: reviews_subject_target
reviews_subject_target.value:
("reviews"."subject" = 'reservation' AND "reviews"."reservation_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."table_session_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("reviews"."subject" = 'visit' AND "reviews"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."reservation_id" IS NULL)

reviews_author.name: reviews_author
reviews_author.value: NOT ("reviews"."author_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "reviews"."author_guest_id" IS NOT NULL)

reviews_guest_email.name: reviews_guest_email
reviews_guest_email.value: "reviews"."author_guest_id" IS NULL OR "reviews"."author_email" IS NOT NULL

reviews_report_reason.name: reviews_report_reason
reviews_report_reason.value: "reviews"."reported_at" IS NULL OR length(trim("reviews"."report_reason")) BETWEEN 10 AND 500

table_session_members_identity.name: table_session_members_identity
table_session_members_identity.value: NOT ("table_session_members"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "table_session_members"."guest_id" IS NOT NULL)

table_sessions_closed_consistency.name: table_sessions_closed_consistency
table_sessions_closed_consistency.value: ("table_sessions"."status" = 'open' AND "table_sessions"."closed_at" IS NULL) OR ("table_sessions"."status" = 'closed' AND "table_sessions"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL)
